story_type: airliner down in a lagoon, boat pickup off the wing
hook: This passenger jet came down in the lagoon, short of the runway
narration: This passenger jet came down in the lagoon, a quarter mile short of the runway.
Navy divers from Underwater Construction Team Two were working right nearby.
They aimed their inflatable boat straight at the wing.
People were already out there, standing on it, ankle deep in water.
In a water landing, people leave through the exits over the wing and wait on it for boats.
So the sailors pulled them aboard and ran them to shore, load after load.
Local boats came out to help.
[short pause] Behind them, the jet was slowly going under.
outcome: The sailors shuttled passengers and crew to shore before the jet sank in a hundred feet of water.
title: Passenger jet crashed into a lagoon
description:
On Sept. 28, 2018, Air Niugini flight PX56 crashed into Chuuk Lagoon about a quarter mile short of the runway. U.S. Navy Sailors from Underwater Construction Team 2, working nearby, shuttled passengers and crew to shore in their inflatable boat before the plane sank.

Footage: U.S. Navy video by Chief Petty Officer Matthew White, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/630182/underwater-construction-team-2-rescuing-passengers-and-crew-members-crashed-air-nuigini-flight-px56
